question: According to Census of India 2011, which district in India has the lowest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __Alirajpur__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to the Census 2011:-**

 
 
• Alirajpur district has the lowest literacy rate in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Alirajpur is considered the poorest city of India with more than 70% population lives below the poverty line.
 
• It was the least literate district in India based on the 2011 Census.
 
• The female literacy rate in Alirajpur is 31.0% and the male literacy rate is 43.6%.
 
• The total literacy rate in Madhya Pradesh is 69.32%.
 
• Jabalpur has the highest literacy rate in Madhya Pradesh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Serchip:-

 
 
• In Mizoram it was the most literate district in India based on the 2011 Census.
 
 
 
• Barwani, Jhabhua:-
 
 
• These​ are the districts in Madhya Pradesh under the Indore division.
 
 
 
• Sheopur:-
 
 
• It is a city in Madhya Pradesh under the Chambal division.
